camera.shot_scale_bias: balanced coverage: establishing wide, then medium two-shots and clean close-ups
camera.height: chest height on a fluid head

lens.dof: deep focus with the subject crisply separated

sources: a warm key through a soft frame
a rim light carving the hair line
lighting.practicals: motivated table lamps and window slats, all flattering

rules: subjects blocked to the thirds and lit to be looked at
composition.movement_of_subject: actors hit marks; movement is staged, entrances and exits framed

sound.ambience_bias: clean, close dialogue presence over a quiet, tidy room tone

music.instrumentation: A full string orchestra with muted brass
music.dynamics: swelling under entrances and settling beneath dialogue

must_include: the framing is composed, never caught

notes: The studio machine at its most confident: staged, lit, upholstered.
